App Features:
Sends ticket create/update events to a Discord channel; configurable webhook per install; optional filters (e.g. high-priority)

Goals
 - Improve ticket visibility for support and ops teams via Discord.
 - Enable real-time ticket updates without leaving Discord.

User Stories
- As a team lead, I want new tickets posted in Discord so the team can triage quickly.
 - As an agent, I want escalated tickets in Discord so I can react in time.
 - As an admin, I want to configure which events and channels receive notifications.
Functional Requirements:
- On ticket create, send a Discord webhook with subject, requester, priority, status (Must)
- On ticket update, send a webhook when status or priority changes (Must)
- Configure Discord webhook URL in iparams during install (Must)
- Optionally filter by priority (e.g. only high/urgent) (Should)
- Include ticket ID and link to ticket in Freshdesk/FS (Must)
- Embed format: subject, requester email, priority, status, created date(Must)
- Handle webhook failures (log, optional retry) (Should)
Success Criteria:
- All configured ticket create events result in Discord message
- Webhook delivers within 30 seconds of event
- Configurable webhook URL saved and used correctly
- App passes fdk validate
- App installs and runs without runtime errors
Platform Features:
Serverless events
Request templates
iparams (webhook URL)
App Setup event - onAppInstall

Webhook Resource
Intro to Discord Apps

App Features:
Sends ticket/contact events to any webhook URL (Zapier, Make, n8n, custom); event type and payload filters

Goals
- Integrate with automation tools using webhooks.
- Work with any service that accepts HTTP webhooks.

User Stories
- As a user, I want ticket events sent to my Zapier/Make/n8n workflows.
- As an admin, I want to choose which events trigger the webhook.
- As a developer, I want a JSON payload I can parse.
Functional Requirements:
- Store webhook URL in iparams
- Support events: onTicketCreate, onTicketUpdate (optionally onContactCreate)
- Multi-select event types in iparams
- POST JSON payload with ticket/contact fields and event type
- Payload shape: 
   { 
     eventType, 
     timestamp, 
     ticket: { 
         id,
         subject,
         status,
         priority,
         requester_email 
     }
   }
- Retry on 5xx or network failure (e.g. 2 retries)
- Optional custom headers (e.g. auth) in iparams
Success Criteria:
- Selected events trigger webhook POST
- Target receives valid JSON with defined structure
- Event type filter matches configuration
- App passes fdk validate
- Retry occurs on failure
